brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and effectiveness of an investigational drug in patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
brief_title: An Investigational Drug Study in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (MK0431-023)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients at least 18 years of age and not older than 75 who have a specific type of diabetes called Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18 years of age or older than 75
* Any condition, which in the opinion of the investigator, may not be in the patient's best interest to participate

official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of MK0431 in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in A1C at Week 18
